name: Two admins accruing the same period at the same moment create one set of liabilities
title: SC-13-05-04 Two admins accruing the same period at the same moment create one set of liabilities
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F2
When two manager sessions accrue period "Ekim 2026" in parallel
Then exactly one request accrues 6 units and the other accrues 0, creating nothing
And exactly 6 liabilities exist
And the ledger invariants hold
